english: Got yourself a nice weapon, eh?
As your gloved hand wraps around the handle, a chill runs up your arm.
In the corner of your eye.
There's nothing here but dust and bones.
You look down at the mace.
Your body seems to FAIL when you hold it.
Something is very, very wrong with it.
What, is it cursed? Did I just get cursed?
But you know it was there.
No, I mean... they're still here.
You move to secure it on your back.
As long as you're not wielding it.
You find this lovely weapon- ready to take on the city's foulness.
And you simply CANNOT wield it.
The horror - like some un-fleshy ghast come to haunt you - is too great.
